record.paper_title: Concerning the open problems in Kazuyuki Sawaguchi's Kokon Sampoki
record.original_question: Let x and y be the two legs of a right triangle, z its hypotenuse, u the altitude from the right angle to the hypotenuse, and v the side length of a square hole inside the triangle, all measured in sun. The area remaining outside the square is 350 square bu, so (1/2)xy - v^2 = 350. Also, five sevenths of the leg y plus two thirds of the altitude u is 4 shaku 5 sun, i.e. (5/7)y + (2/3)u = 45. Together with the right-triangle and altitude relations x^2 + y^2 = z^2 and xy = uz, find x, y, z, u, and v.

evidence.quote: 今鈎股弦 (直角三角形) があり、図のように平方 (正方形) の空があり、外余の面積は 350 歩、股の 5/7 と中鈎の 2/3 を加えると 4 尺 5 寸である。鈎股弦中鈎方面を求めよ。
鈎を x, 股を y, 弦を z, 中鈎を u, 方面を v とすると、1/2 xy - v^2 = A, 5/7 y + 2/3 u = B, x^2 + y^2 = z^2, xy = uz
